claim: Identify and build a Pixel6 S5123 CPIF candidate against the installed kernel before any modem power transition; derive the exact reserved-memory, GPIO and PCI dependencies from pinned GS101 and stock sources.
oracle: ABI-matched isolated build, explicit dependency and lifecycle audit, no unreviewed stubs presented as working recovery, and no phone modem/partition side effects in M0.

user_journey.scenario: User inserts the China Mobile SIM and expects registration, mobile data, API requests and calls after boot, reconnection and recovery. M0 establishes prerequisites without disturbing the currently recovered desktop.
user_journey.expected: No claim of cellular service until SIM/registration, real bearer traffic and voice are separately observed.

invariants: Use GS101 S5123 source and board data; never substitute GS201 S5300 addresses or calibration.
All reference inputs pinned; isolate candidate and output from shared kernel source.
Trace modem probe/remove/shutdown, DMA reservations, IRQ ownership, power sequencing and PCI relink callbacks before loading.
Actual NV partitions remain read-only. Later daemons receive verified RAM copies only.
Do not copy or distribute unlicensed tinycbd; inspect licensed/stock-user-owned alternatives before userspace integration.
gitnexus: External kernel not indexed; direct source/control-flow/dependency tracing required.
ast: Compile candidate with exact kernel headers and W=1; inspect exported-symbol resolution.

unit.red: Target deterministic failures found by source audit, such as channel classification or teardown ordering; not applicable to inventory alone.
unit.green: Applicable actual-code contracts must pass before hardware gate.
